title: Open a savings sub-account for a member
description: Open an additional savings share for an existing member and return the new account number and confirmation reference. The final step commits the account and cannot be undone.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member to open the share for.

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: Operator-visible name for the new share.

inputs.name: initial_deposit
inputs.description: Opening deposit; the product minimum is 25.00.

inputs.name: funding_account
inputs.description: The existing account the opening deposit is drawn from.

outputs.name: new_account_number
outputs.description: The account number that was opened.
